title: Arizona attorney general threatens lawsuit over south Phoenix data center
key_facts: Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes, a Democrat, threatened to sue an AI data center developer at a town hall in Mesa on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026.
The MenLo Digital project in Ahwatukee, south Phoenix, is under construction; about 150 residents attended.
Resident Ana Marshall said she recorded noise as loud as 110 decibels inside her son's bedroom.
Mayes is investigating under Arizona's public nuisance law; she cannot confirm what action or when.
Nearly 50 data centers are under construction or in development across Arizona.
In August Mayes urged the Legislature and Governor Katie Hobbs to impose a moratorium; she cannot impose one alone.
quote_evidence: "I do not believe that Arizona has in place what it needs to adequately protect our communities from the negative impacts of the data center build up that is on the way," Mayes said.
"It seemed to us like an obvious investigation to launch," she said.
why_it_matters_hint: A state official is using nuisance law against a data center.
